csv_project_name: AE for New Madison County Fairgrounds Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Madison County, Idaho, is requesting Statements of Qualifications from qualified engineering firms to provide professional engineering and planning services for the evaluation, conceptual design, site planning, infrastructure assessment, and preliminary cost estimating associated with the proposed development of a new Madison County Fairgrounds facility. The project site consists of approximately 78.5 acres. Services may include site evaluation, master planning, conceptual design, infrastructure planning, development phasing, cost estimating, and related professional engineering services.
